description: Suggests holiday destinations for a natural-language request (e.g. 'warm beach in November with small children'). Returns destination ideas with an indicative package price per person, the reason each one matches, and the countryCode that search_packages accepts. Suited to requests without a chosen destination country. Read-only.

query.description: What the user is looking for, in one or two short sentences, including the constraints that apply to this search (e.g. 'sunny beach holiday in June from Warsaw, 2 adults and a 5-year-old, under 6000 PLN').

name: search_inspirations
title: Search destination ideas
